summary: The default GLM-5.3-Flash TP2 preset serves the checkpoint with csf_32x2_v1 expert scales through FlashInfer's new CSF path
compatibility: PRESET=glm53-tp2 downloads revision 96f27f8c of branch qad2-kda-w8a16-csf (the same weights as 0a041763, with routed-expert scales in the csf_32x2_v1 block encoding; about 177 GB). Images without FlashInfer's CSF block loader keep serving 0a041763.
details: The launcher recognizes FP4-CSF checkpoints whose ModelOpt recipes use the csf_32x2_v1 scale encoding and refuses one before downloading it when the image's vLLM or B12X cannot read that encoding.

Deployment presets can list several fallbacks, each for an image without the named vLLM variables or CSF scale encodings; glm53-tp2 falls back to the slab-CSF revision 0a041763, and on a vLLM without VLLM_GLM53_KDA_MXFP8_ACTIVATION_MODE to dec48abd.
